column1: # EXP26001055 / cDNA007 - blocking oligo v1 vs v2 across three PHH inputs.
# SeqPool0189, flow cell PBM77529, run 20260813_1441_P2I-00507-B.
# Built from the Benchling BFX request (cDNA007_HBV Translational BFX, 8/7/2026).
# DESIGN. A clean 2 x 3 factorial: blocker version (v1, v2) x input (10 ng, 1 ng, 100 pg).
# All six libraries are the SAME intracellular PHH poly(A)-enriched RNA pool - identical
# nine source entities (RNA-TCB-0238-0524 through 0368-0588), the same pool used for
# cDNA006 SeqLib5665 and cDNA003. There is therefore NO biological variation between
# libraries; every difference is blocker, input, or noise.
# PRIMARY ENDPOINT. Whether the new blockers reduce mid-read barcode / concatemer events.
# That is measured directly by filter_concatemers.py, and cDNA003 already provides an
# input-matched baseline measured with the same code at the same settings:
# so v1 and v2 can be compared against those at matched input. cDNA003 did NOT use the
# reduced PCR cycling that cDNA007 does, so blocker and cycle count are confounded when
# comparing across experiments - the clean comparison is v1 vs v2 WITHIN this run.
# pcr is NA: the entry says cycling was reduced but does not state the number. Needed to
# separate blocker effect from cycle effect against the cDNA003 baseline.
